spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact <microphone> element surface (HTMLMicrophoneElement, setConstraints with echoCancellation, track/cancel/error events) plus a clearly separated getUserMedia audio fallback and a live level meter.

interactive.rationale: Echo-cancellation select, apply-constraints, fallback, and stop controls all drive real API state; the meter animates from the live audio track.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the ChromeStatus framing of a single-capability audio-capture control.

edge_cases.rationale: setConstraints on an unsupported browser reports why it is unavailable; fallback failure (NotFoundError in the headless run) and cancellation are reported honestly; flag-enable steps are given for pre-153 browsers.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the new v153 feature-level suite, including microphone interface, setConstraints, event handlers, and a can-return-false HTMLUnknownElement check. No existing suite was edited.

runtime_evidence.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/capability-elements-camera-and-microphone --no-server passed both classes after final edits; screenshots read. CDP sweep exercised echo select change, configure, fallback, and stop: honest degradation messages, meter stayed 0 without a track, zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables throughout; controls keep readable text on their backgrounds; focus-visible outlines present.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select, native buttons, aria-labelled meter, and an aria-live status output for every state change; controls stack full-width on narrow viewports.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness run passed mobile (360x740 DPR3) and desktop (1280x800) with no horizontal overflow; the page's own controls are full-width on mobile with comfortable tap heights (min-height 2.75rem).

guidanceConsulted.query: declarative media capture element fallback and permission prompt UX
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose changing state non-visually (live regions / semantic output) and keep every control programmatically named.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status is an aria-live <output>; the level meter is a native <meter> with aria-label; the echo-cancellation choice is a labelled <select>.

guidanceConsulted.query: declarative media capture element fallback and permission prompt UX
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native semantics for interactive controls and honest declarative fallbacks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native <microphone> element is primary; the getUserMedia path is a separate, explicitly labelled fallback button rather than a silent substitute.

summary: v153 refile of the v152 microphone-control concept for the Chrome 153 shipping milestone. Milestone references updated; the unsupported message now includes the CameraAndMicrophoneElements flag with exact enable steps. Verified via the responsive harness (both classes OK, screenshots read) and a CDP interaction sweep with zero console errors.
